_comment: Built-in resource presets for 8sync gguf serve. Each preset maps to llama-server flags.
_custom_hint: Add your own entries below the built-ins. Custom entries survive updates.

max.description: All layers on GPU, large context, 4 parallel slots — best quality, needs 10+ GB VRAM
max.notes: Requires high-end GPU (RTX 3080+). OOM -> try 'high' instead.

high.description: Most layers on GPU, balanced context — good for 6-8 GB VRAM cards
high.notes: Safe default for RTX 3060 / RX 6700 XT class cards.

medium.description: Split CPU+GPU, moderate context — for 4 GB VRAM or shared-memory GPUs
medium.notes: Slower inference but fits most laptops with dedicated GPU.

low.description: CPU-primary, minimal GPU offload — for integrated graphics or no GPU
low.notes: Pure CPU mode. Slow but stable on any hardware.

custom_presets._hint: Define your own named presets here. Keys become usable as '8sync gguf serve --preset <key>'.

_example.notes: Optimized for Qwen3.5-4B.Q8_0 — full GPU fit on 12GB.
